item.text: For the history, BLS Table A in the current July 2026 CPI release exposes seven 2026 seasonally adjusted all-items month-over-month prints: January through July. I’m using that same variant as the September target: CPI-U all items, U.S. city average, seasonally adjusted monthly percent change.
